prompt: In user.js export `SignupSchema` (a zod schema) and `parseSignup(input)`. Fields: email (valid email, normalized to lowercase); password (at least 12 chars, error message exactly 'password too short'); age (optional integer >= 13, error message exactly 'too young'); tags (array of unique non-empty strings, defaults to [], duplicate error message exactly 'duplicate tag'). parseSignup returns {ok: true, data} or {ok: false, errors} where errors maps each failing field name to its first error message. Use the zod version this project has installed.
